records.title: A Main choke isolation with Shear and Razorvine
records.description: Place Shear across the A Main approach into A Garden, beyond the choke so it triggers after an attacker commits. Set Razorvine on the open site-side floor behind the wall to cover the follow-up path. Hold from A Site cover and activate the nest as the wall isolates the entry. Keep both devices clear of moving wall tracks and match the open approach shown in the guide.

source.author: Chef
source.evidence: Primary YouTube page identifies Chef; the creator Share > Embed panel supplied the external iframe. Actual Summit footage at0:04-0:20 shows Shear across the A Main/A Garden passage and Razorvine placed on the site-side floor. Source transcript and frames reviewed. Summit released in13.00 and has no relevant local geometry update identified through13.08; later utility changes concerning moving doors mean the setup is limited to the demonstrated open approach and placements clear of moving tracks. Compatibility is inferred from source footage and patch/map history, not independently tested in a live match.

records.title: B Main choke isolation with Shear and Razorvine
records.description: Place Shear across the B Main entry to site, then set Razorvine on the open B Site floor behind the choke. Hold from site cover and activate the nest when the wall catches an attacker entering. The guide also demonstrates a higher crate placement; keep utility off the moving doorway tracks and use the open wall state shown in the source.
